questions.question:
9 is related to 83 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 13 is related to 171. To which of the following is 15 related, following the same logic?

NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number² + 2 = 2nd number.**

9 is related to 83

→ 9² + 2

→ 81 + 2

→ 83

13 is related to 171

→ 132 + 2

→ 169 + 2

→ 171

Similarly,

15 is related to

→ 152 + 2

→ 225 + 2

**→ 227**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:

questions.solution:

**Logic: (1st number)² - 3rd number = 2nd number.**

(7, 40, 9 )

→ 7² - 9 

→ 49 - 9 

→ 40 = 2nd number.

(9,71, 10)

→ 92 - 10 

→ 81 - 10

→ 71 = 2nd number.

Similarly,

Option 3) (13, 150, 19)

→ 132 - 19 

→ 169 - 19

**→ 150 = 2nd number.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All trees are branches.

Some branches are leaves.

Conclusions:

(I) All leaves are branches.

(II) All leave are trees.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc2cea5872366acb4226c45fb09e32d2f226c3a0227640afb6d050c063822f7a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cb052862c250564d89b4fe60962897a45f136c6d7b723ce0155751e9a85986b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) All leaves are branches → False( As, All trees are branches and Some branches are leaves. so, All leaves are branches can be a possibility, but not definite) 

(II) All leave are trees → False( As, there is no direct relation between leaves and trees. so, All leaves are tress can be a possibility, but not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

56 − 14 × 7 ÷ 22 + 63 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, the signs are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Symbol
 +
 −
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 New Symbol
 −
 +
 ÷
 ×
 
 

Now,

Given e×pression: 56 − 14 × 7 ÷ 22 + 63 = ?

After interchanging the specified signs:

⇒ 56 + 14 ÷ 7 × 22 − 63

Perform operations according to BODMAS

⇒ 56 + __**14 ÷ 7**__ × 22 − 63

⇒ 56 + __**2 × 22**__ − 63

⇒ __**56 + 44**__ − 63

⇒ __**100 − 63**__

⇒ 37

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

12 * 3 * 4 = 6 * 8 * 8
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

Given equation: 12 * 3 * 4 = 6 * 8 * 8

**1) ×, −, ×, +**

Equation: 12 × 3 − 4 = 6 × 8 + 8

__**12 × 3**__ − 4 = __**6 × 8**__ + 8

36 − 4 = 48 + 8

32 = 56 (False)

**2) ×, +, −, ×**

Equation: 12 × 3 + 4 = 6 − 8 × 8

__**12 × 3**__ + 4 = 6 − __**8 × 8**__

36 + 4 = 6 − 64

40 = -58 (False)

**3) ×, +, ×, −**

Equation: 12 × 3 + 4 = 6 × 8 − 8

__**12 × 3**__ + 4 = __**6 × 8**__ − 8

36 + 4 = 48 − 8 

**40 = 40 (True)**

**4) +, ×, −, +**

Equation: 12 + 3 × 4 = 6 − 8 + 8

12 + 3 × 4 = 6 − 8 + 8

12 + 12 = -2 + 8

24 = 6 (False)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
